title: 第23章 灵根测试
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
郁凌急了，怎么他爸妈和姐姐都不信呢？

    “爷爷，要不你再表演一个浮空术，让他们看看。”

    郁凌想到爷爷那手浮空的法术，整个人都兴奋了起来。

    郁凡叹了口气，为了让他的孩子们相信自己真的是在修炼，只好动用灵力让自己浮空起来。

    郁嘉庆和盛素华以及郁颜眼睁睁的看着郁凡飘了起来，皆是震惊的瞪大了眼睛。

    郁颜甚至忍不住上前，仔细的观察了一番，确定了爷爷真的不是在吊威压。

    郁凡轻抬双手，书房里的书柜，书桌等物品都浮空飘荡了起来。

    甚至桌上的茶壶，还给杯子斟上一一杯灵茶，随后便朝着郁凡而来。

    郁凡伸手拿过灵茶，喝了一口，才抬眸看到他的儿孙们那不可置信的表情。

    “爷爷真的太厉害了！”郁凌兴奋的说，“这下你们信了吧？”

    郁嘉庆扶好自己差点掉落的下巴，原来他曾经的想法是真的！

    他爸一直在修仙！

    郁嘉庆深呼了一口气才稳定下自己的情绪，“爸，你修炼的事情一直没有告诉我们，为什么今天这么突然？”

    他有些疑惑，虽然郁凡并没有想隐瞒，但显然之前也没有想要告诉他们的意思。

    郁凌兴奋的举手，“我我我，这个问题我知道！因为我今天发现了爷爷从后山飘了下来！”

    郁嘉庆：......

    搞半天原来是被发现了才说。

    郁凡尴尬的咳嗽了一声，“这件事本来就准备跟你说的，只是还没准备好，不知道怎么跟你们开口。”

    这倒是真的，郁凡可从来就没有想要隐瞒自己的孩子们过。

    “既然现在你们都知道了修炼的事情，那我就直说了。”

    郁凡扫了一眼面带兴奋的家人们，“我可以带你们修炼，但修炼并不是一件简单的事情，你们自己可以好好想想是不是要去做这件事。”

    “想清楚再回答。”

    郁凌第一个开口，“爷爷，我不用说，我肯定是要修炼的！我已经想得很清楚了。”

    郁嘉庆想了想问郁凡：“爸，是不是你永远也不会再变老了？”
content_en:
Yu Ling was anxious, why didn't his parents and sister believe it?

"Grandpa, why don't you perform another levitation technique and let them see it."

Yu Ling became excited when she thought of her grandfather's floating magic.

Yu Fan sighed. In order to make his children believe that he was really practicing, he had to use his spiritual power to float into the air.

Yu Jiaqing, Sheng Suhua and Yu Yan watched Yu Fan float up, their eyes widening in shock.

Yu Yan couldn't help but step forward and observed carefully, making sure that grandpa was really not trying to exert pressure.

Yu Fan raised his hands lightly, and the bookcases, desks and other items in the study began to float in the air.

He even poured a cup of spiritual tea into the teapot on the table, and then came towards Yu Fan.

Yu Fan reached out and took the spirit tea, took a sip, and then raised his eyes to see the incredulous expressions of his children and grandchildren.

"Grandpa is really amazing!" Yu Ling said excitedly, "Do you believe it now?"

Yu Jiaqing held up his chin that almost dropped. It turned out that what he had thought was true!

His dad has been cultivating immortality!

Yu Jiaqing took a deep breath to calm down his emotions, "Dad, you never told us about your cultivation. Why is it so sudden today?"

He was a little confused. Although Yu Fan didn't want to hide it, he obviously had no intention of telling them before.

Yu Ling raised his hands excitedly, "Me, me, I know this problem! Because I found grandpa floating down from the back mountain today!"

Yu Jiaqing:......

It took me a long time to say it, but it turned out that I was discovered.

Yu Fan coughed awkwardly, "I was planning to tell you about this, but I'm just not ready yet. I don't know how to talk to you."

This is true, Yu Fanke has never wanted to hide his children.

"Now that you all know about cultivation, I will tell you directly."

Yu Fan glanced at his excited family members and said, "I can lead you to practice, but practice is not a simple thing. You can think carefully about whether you want to do it."

"Think carefully before answering."

Yu Ling was the first to speak, "Grandpa, I don't need to say, I definitely want to practice! I have already thought about it clearly."

Yu Jiaqing thought for a while and asked Yu Fan: "Dad, will you never grow old again?"
